name: War of the Chosen
description: The War of the Chosen expansion: resistance factions (Reapers, Skirmishers, Templars), the Chosen, Infirmary/Training Center/Resistance Ring facilities, and the removal of the Advanced Warfare Center.
attribution_text: Firaxis Games / 2K Games (facts only, no bundled assets -- ADR-0008)
ingestion_notes: Authored from UFOpaedia WotC-tagged pages and Fextralife cross-references, November 2026. The Advanced Warfare Center is explicitly NOT re-declared in this pack (it has no WOTC buildable-facility equivalent); its vanilla object from xcom2-base remains importable but is flagged with a WOTC-unavailability tag for UI filtering -- see objects.json.
